Adaptations are offered under CC BY-SA 4.0, using the later same-elements licence option in section 4(2) of the original Korean licence. Unmodified source text retains its original licence. Native-speaker review is pending; no official exam membership or dictionary-provider endorsement is claimed.

National Institute of Korean Language, 2017 International Standard Curriculum for the Korean Language (vocabulary spreadsheet revised 2020): headword grade evidence, under Korea Open Government Licence Type 1 (attribution). https://www.korean.go.kr/front/reportData/reportDataView.do?mn_id=207&report_seq=932 . Lingonberry collocations: Original Lingonberry collocation examples and translations, 2026, MIT. Common lexical combinations are factual material. AI-assisted authoring; fluent-speaker certification remains pending. No dictionary definitions, publisher exercise banks or source example sentences are copied. This is a starter covering every current study-level filter, not full dictionary coverage. Original phrase glosses, examples, translations and answer alternatives are MIT. Collocation meanings describe the phrase's use and may extend beyond an anchor word's currently selected dictionary sense. Study levels follow existing anchor IDs; they do not certify the sentence's exam level.
